correctness.rationale: Let A=C_N with N=2^{m-1} and index-two conjugation exponent r. Every nonfixed lambda_k has orbit {k,rk}, induces a degree-two irreducible with kernel ker lambda_k and codegree N/gcd(N,k). For dihedral and quaternion r=-1, and for semidihedral r=2^{m-2}-1; all have exactly k=0,N/2 fixed and four linear characters with codegrees 1 once and 2 thrice. Their character orders 2^j (2<=j<=m-1) appear in 2^{j-2} induced pairs. For modular r=2^{m-2}+1, even k are fixed and the abelianization is C_{2^{m-2}}xC_2, yielding 2^j linears of codegree 2^j (2<=j<=m-2); odd k give 2^{m-3} faithful degree-two characters of codegree 2^{m-1}. Degree-squared counts give |G|=2^m. Direct independently scripted orbit enumeration at m=4,5,6,7 gives the formulas, but all-order derivation is Clifford theory.

originality.rationale: The Moreto invariant and the known dihedral-generalized-quaternion collision are prior input. Lewis--Yan treat equality with abelian p-group pseudo-algebras and general structural constraints, not the exact four cyclic-index-two family comparison. Semidihedral coincidence and modular contrast complete a natural classification not obtained merely by the older D-Q example. General Clifford theory is credited, not claimed new.
